ai_positioning.summary: InterDigital does not mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its 10-K filing. The company focuses on wireless technology licensing and patent portfolio management.

risks.title: Uncertain revenue expansion opportunities
risks.score_rationale: Plans to expand revenue into video and cloud-based service licensing are uncertain as this market is less developed than device-based licensing. Service providers may use alternative technologies and lack comparable agreement benchmarks.
risks.summary: The company seeks to expand licensing activities to video and cloud-based service providers but faces uncertainty due to market immaturity and potential customer holdout behavior.

risks.title: Patent licensing negotiation challenges
risks.score_rationale: Negotiations with service providers for license agreements may be protracted and difficult, potentially delaying revenue realization and impacting financial results.
risks.summary: Patent licensing negotiations with service providers can be lengthy and complex, creating uncertainty in revenue timing.

risks.title: Intellectual property litigation risks
risks.score_rationale: The company faces significant litigation exposure in defending its intellectual property rights and patent portfolio, with potential adverse judgments.
risks.summary: Substantial exposure to intellectual property litigation and patent defense proceedings that could impact operations and financial condition.

risks.title: Patent law regulatory changes
risks.score_rationale: Potential reforms to patent legislation could materially impact the company's ability to enforce and protect intellectual property rights effectively.
risks.summary: Changes in patent legislation could adversely affect the company's capacity to defend and enforce its intellectual property portfolio.

risks.title: US-China trade and geopolitical tensions
risks.score_rationale: Deteriorating US-China relations could negatively impact business operations through tariffs, trade restrictions, and political pressure on technology licensing.
risks.summary: Trade conflicts and geopolitical tensions between the US and China could materially affect business operations and licensing arrangements.

risks.title: Macroeconomic uncertainty
risks.score_rationale: Economic uncertainty in mobile device markets could reduce customer capacity to enter into new licensing agreements and impact licensing revenue.
risks.summary: Macroeconomic headwinds may reduce market demand for new licensing agreements and delay customer decision-making.

risks.title: Royalty determination uncertainty
risks.score_rationale: The determination of royalty rates in licensing agreements involves uncertainty and could impact the revenue generated from licensing arrangements.
risks.summary: Uncertainty in determining appropriate royalty rates for licensing agreements may impact revenue realization.

governance.voting_structure: Une seule classe d'actions ordinaires, 1 vote par action.

fr.activity: InterDigital développe des technologies sans fil innovantes et accorde des licences pour ces innovations.
fr.products: Ses inventions sont intégrées dans des smartphones, des appareils connectés et des réseaux 5G, comme ceux utilisés par Samsung ou Apple.
fr.customers: Les fabricants d'appareils électroniques et les opérateurs de télécommunications achètent ses licences pour utiliser ses technologies brevetées.
fr.edge: InterDigital est un pionnier dans les technologies sans fil, possédant un portefeuille de brevets essentiel pour la connectivité moderne.

en.activity: InterDigital develops innovative wireless technologies and licenses these innovations.
en.products: Its inventions are integrated into smartphones, connected devices, and 5G networks, such as those used by Samsung or Apple.
en.customers: Manufacturers of electronic devices and telecommunications operators purchase its licenses to use its patented technologies.
en.edge: InterDigital is a pioneer in wireless technologies, holding a patent portfolio essential for modern connectivity.

de.activity: InterDigital entwickelt innovative Funktechnologien und lizenziert diese Innovationen.
de.products: Seine Erfindungen sind in Smartphones, vernetzten Geräten und 5G-Netzwerken integriert, wie sie von Samsung oder Apple verwendet werden.
de.customers: Hersteller von Elektronikgeräten und Telekommunikationsanbieter erwerben seine Lizenzen zur Nutzung seiner patentierten Technologien.
de.edge: InterDigital ist ein Pionier im Bereich der Funktechnologien und verfügt über ein Patentportfolio, das für die moderne Konnektivität unerlässlich ist.

fr.positioning: InterDigital se positionne comme un développeur de propriété intellectuelle et un concédant de licences dans le domaine des technologies sans fil, distinct des fabricants de puces ou d'appareils finaux comme Qualcomm ou Apple.
fr.tech_products: Ses innovations portent sur les normes 5G NR, Wi-Fi 6/6E, et le traitement de signaux avancés, constituant un cœur technologique pour les futurs réseaux mobiles et IoT.
fr.moat: Un large portefeuille de brevets fondamentaux dans les standards de communication sans fil, renforcé par des licences accordées à de grands acteurs de l'industrie, crée une barrière à l'entrée significative.
fr.risks: La dépendance aux revenus de licences et la nécessité de négocier continuellement de nouveaux accords avec des clients parfois réticents constituent un risque structurel.

en.positioning: InterDigital positions itself as an intellectual property developer and licensor in wireless technologies, distinct from chip or end-device manufacturers like Qualcomm or Apple.
en.tech_products: Its innovations focus on 5G NR, Wi-Fi 6/6E standards, and advanced signal processing, forming a technological core for future mobile and IoT networks.
en.moat: A broad portfolio of fundamental patents in wireless communication standards, reinforced by licenses granted to major industry players, creates a significant barrier to entry.
en.risks: Dependence on licensing revenue and the need to continually negotiate new agreements with sometimes reluctant customers represent a structural risk.

de.positioning: InterDigital positioniert sich als Entwickler von geistigem Eigentum und Lizenzgeber im Bereich der Funktechnologien, getrennt von Chipherstellern oder Endgeräteherstellern wie Qualcomm oder Apple.
de.tech_products: Seine Innovationen konzentrieren sich auf die Standards 5G NR, Wi-Fi 6/6E und fortschrittliche Signalverarbeitung, die einen technologischen Kern für zukünftige Mobilfunk- und IoT-Netzwerke bilden.
de.moat: Ein breites Portfolio an grundlegenden Patenten in Funkkommunikationsstandards, ergänzt durch Lizenzen für große Branchenakteure, schafft eine erhebliche Eintrittsbarriere.
de.risks: Die Abhängigkeit von Lizenzgebühren und die Notwendigkeit, kontinuierlich neue Vereinbarungen mit teilweise widerwilligen Kunden auszuhandeln, stellen ein strukturelles Risiko dar.
